about_short_description.short_description: Revenya Capital is capable of delivering rapid, data-driven financing decisions.

product.name: Revenue-Based Financing (RBF)
product.description: A financing option where companies receive capital in exchange for a percentage of future monthly revenue, with repayments varying based on revenue performance.

identifier.value: AI-Powered Financial Data Analysis and Decisioning

product.name: AI-Powered Financial Data Analysis and Decisioning
product.description: An AI/ML-driven system that analyzes company data to assess financial health, revenue stability, growth potential, and risk profile for financing decisions.

identifier.value: Flexible Repayment and Dynamic Financing Terms

product.name: Flexible Repayment and Dynamic Financing Terms
product.description: Financing with repayments based on a percentage of monthly revenue and adaptable terms that evolve with the company's growth and revenue patterns.

product.name: Insightful AI-Powered Dashboard
product.description: A dashboard providing real-time insights and predictions on a startup’s financial health using AI analytics.

product.name: Shariah Compliant Financing
product.description: Financing solutions that comply with Islamic Shariah principles, ensuring ethical investment practices.
